key_insight: A digital-twin-linked decision support system can automatically tune detonation-gas spraying parameters to improve Ni/Al composite coating quality and reproducibility.
engineering_relevance: This work shows how AI-guided process control can reduce trial-and-error in thermal spraying while targeting coating microstructure metrics important for performance.
method: Hierarchical control: PLC sequencing, real-time jet stabilization, predictive quality regulation.
Response Surface Methodology with second-order regression to map process parameters to coating structure.
Multi-objective optimization using Harrington desirability plus a genetic algorithm.
evidence_signal: SEM-based evaluation and ANOVA-supported models showed gas temperature and spray distance had the strongest effect, with mean prediction error kept within about 5–8%.
watch_item: The approach depends on accurate diagnostics and calibrated models, so transfer to other spray systems may require re-training and process-specific validation.
paper_title: Methods and Algorithms for Automation of Process Control in the Formation of Composite Coatings
